title: Lunar Lander (PhET-style AS2 simulation)

inputs.name: Left Arrow key (keyCode 37)
inputs.description: Calls myLander.angleLeft(), rotating the lander counter-clockwise by 3 degrees per keydown while in flight, and always plays the left-thruster animation/sound unless crashLanded.

inputs.name: Right Arrow key (keyCode 39)
inputs.description: Calls myLander.angleRight(), rotating the lander clockwise by 3 degrees per keydown while in flight, and always plays the right-thruster animation/sound unless crashLanded.

inputs.name: Up Arrow key (keyCode 38)
inputs.description: Calls myLander.increaseThrust(), raising thrust by 5% of maxThrust (2250 units) per keydown, clamped to [0, maxThrust] and gated by remaining fuel.

inputs.name: Down Arrow key (keyCode 40)
inputs.description: Calls myLander.decreaseThrust(), lowering thrust by 5% of maxThrust (2250 units) per keydown, clamped to [0, maxThrust].

inputs.name: Spacebar (keyCode 32)
inputs.description: Toggles thrust between 0 and full maxThrust (45000): if current thrust is exactly 0, sets it to maxThrust, else sets it to 0.

inputs.name: P key (keyCode 80)
inputs.description: Toggles pause: if paused, resumes (restartMotion, replays alarm sound, hides 'paused' sign); if running, pauses (stopMotion, stops all sounds, shows 'paused' sign).

inputs.name: R key (keyCode 82)
inputs.description: Calls _root.reset(), which re-initializes the lander, score, camera, and clears landing marks.

inputs.name: Start button (introPlaque_mc.startButton_mc)
inputs.description: Wrapped in a ControlButton with buttonAction = null; press/release plays a 2px 'pressed' nudge animation but its bound action is null.

inputs.name: Reset button (view2_mc.resetButton_mc)
inputs.description: Wrapped in a ControlButton bound to _root.reset; release (click) triggers the same reset as the R key.

inputs.name: Help button (view2_mc.helpButton_mc)
inputs.description: onPress calls _root.help(), which toggles a pause + help-plaque overlay; onRollOver/onRollOut swap the button's own display frame based on motionPaused.

state.name: pos.x / pos.y
state.description: Lander position in simulation meters; y>=0 is in-flight/on-surface, y<0 is used transiently to detect the ground crossing.

state.name: velocity.x / velocity.y
state.description: Lander velocity in meters/second, integrated each physics tick.

state.name: acceleration.x / acceleration.y
state.description: Current acceleration from thrust and gravity, recomputed each tick.

state.name: angle
state.description: Lander tilt angle; changed by ±3°·(pi/180) per angleLeft/angleRight call while crashState == 'inFlight'.

state.name: cosTheta / sinTheta
state.description: Cached cosine/sine of angle, recomputed whenever angle changes or on a landing/crash reset.

state.name: thrust
state.description: Current thrust magnitude, settable only while remainingFuel > 0.

state.name: maxThrust
state.description: Maximum thrust value, set in Lander.initialize().

state.name: remainingFuel / initialFuel
state.description: Fuel remaining vs. starting fuel (816.5 units); consumed each tick proportional to thrust.

state.name: massEmpty / currentMass
state.description: Dry mass (6839) and currentMass = massEmpty + remainingFuel, recomputed each tick in useFuel().

state.name: specificI
state.description: Specific-impulse-like divisor used to convert thrust*dt into fuel consumed.

state.name: crashState
state.description: Flight/landing status, set in Lander.evolveOneTimeStep().

state.name: landingSpeed
state.description: Speed magnitude at the moment the ground is crossed; undefined while inFlight.

state.name: softLandingSpeed / hardLandingSpeed / damageLandingSpeed
state.description: Speed thresholds (m/s) used to classify a landing's severity.

state.name: boulderCrash
state.description: Set true once the lander body hits the boulders_mc hit-area on either side.

state.name: fuelLowAlarmSounded / fuelOutAlarmSounded
state.description: One-shot flags preventing the low-fuel/out-of-fuel alarm sounds from repeating.

state.name: inMotion
state.description: True while the 40ms physics interval is running.

state.name: t / lastT / intervalID
state.description: Elapsed sim time, last tick's wall-clock timer value, and the setInterval handle for evolveOneTimeStep.

state.name: motionPaused
state.description: Main-timeline pause flag toggled by P key and help().

state.name: mag / Nmag
state.description: Camera zoom factor and a bounded zoom-step counter (-2..1) used by resetView().

state.name: nbrLandings
state.description: Count of landings so far, used to key/remove 'landingMarkN' clips.

state.name: pixPerMeter
state.description: Pixels-per-meter scale used to convert physics coordinates to screen coordinates.

state.name: Constants.g
state.description: Gravitational acceleration (m/s^2) applied every physics tick.

rules.description: Gravitational acceleration used in the physics integration is a fixed 1.6 m/s^2 (lunar gravity).

While airborne (pos.y >= 0), vertical acceleration = thrust*cosTheta/currentMass - g, and horizontal acceleration = thrust*sinTheta/currentMass; entering this branch with pos.y > 0 (re)sets crashState to 'inFlight' and clears landingSpeed.

The moment pos.y crosses below 0 while the previous state was 'inFlight', landingSpeed is captured as sqrt(vx^2+vy^2) of the pre-impact velocity, position/velocity/acceleration are zeroed, orientation is reset upright, thrust is forced to 0, and the landing is classified: landingSpeed < softLandingSpeed(2) and angle < 0.2 rad -> 'softLanded'; else landingSpeed < hardLandingSpeed(6) and angle < 0.2 rad -> 'hardLanded'; otherwise -> 'crashLanded' (fuel forced to 0, angle reset to 0, soundExplosion played).

Position and velocity are integrated each tick using dt = (getTimer()-lastT)/1000 seconds (real elapsed wall-clock time, not a fixed 40ms step): pos += dt*v + 0.5*dt^2*a, v += a*dt, using the acceleration just computed for that tick.

If pos.y would go to or below 0 with downward velocity while not in the 'inFlight' state (i.e. already landed), position/velocity/acceleration are clamped to zero/ground so the lander does not sink through the surface after a landing has been classified.

The physics tick runs on a setInterval firing evolveOneTimeStep every 40ms, started by startMotion() (used on a fresh start) or restartMotion() (used to resume after pause, which re-stamps lastT but does not reset crashState/t); stopMotion() clears the interval.

Fuel is consumed each tick as thrust*dt/specificI(3050); currentMass is recomputed as massEmpty(6839)+remainingFuel. A low-fuel alarm (soundAlarm(1)) fires once when remainingFuel/initialFuel < 0.1, and an out-of-fuel alarm (soundAlarm(3)) fires once when remainingFuel reaches exactly 0; remainingFuel is floor-clamped at 0 and thrust forced to 0 if it would go negative.

setThrust(thrust) only takes effect while remainingFuel > 0. Values in [0, maxThrust] are applied directly, triggering soundThrust() at max, adjustThrustSound(percentage) for intermediate values, or soundThrustOff()+adjustThrustSoundOff() at 0. Values above maxThrust clamp this.thrust to maxThrust but still call adjustThrustSound using the original (uncapped) requested thrust, so the reported percentage can exceed 100.
increaseThrust()/decreaseThrust() each step thrust by ±0.05*maxThrust (±2250 units) via setThrust().

angleRight()/angleLeft(): regardless of flight state, as long as crashState != 'crashLanded' the corresponding side-thruster clip plays its 'begin' animation and soundSideThrust(1) is triggered; the actual angle change of ±3*(pi/180) radians (and recomputation of cosTheta/sinTheta) is applied only when crashState == 'inFlight', i.e. side-thruster visuals/sound can fire while softLanded/hardLanded but the angle itself no longer changes.
Left/Right arrow keys and Up/Down arrow keys call Lander.angleLeft/angleRight and Lander.increaseThrust/decreaseThrust respectively via the main-timeline key listener.
Spacebar sets thrust to the cached local 'maxThrust' (copied from myLander.maxThrust at init) if current thrust is exactly 0, otherwise sets thrust to 0 (full on/off toggle, not incremental).

P key toggles motionPaused: resuming calls myLander.restartMotion() and replays the default alarm sound and hides the paused sign; pausing calls myLander.stopMotion(), stops all sounds, and shows the paused sign.

R key and the Reset button (bound via ControlButton to _root.reset) both call reset(), which reInitializes the lander at (initX=45, initY=50) with velocity (0,0) and all lander stats back to their initial values (fuel, mass, thrust, alarm flags, crash flags), reinitializes the score keeper and its displayed score, hides the boulder-crash and landing-speed report panels, removes every existing 'landingMarkN' clip, resets the camera (view_mc scale to 100%, position to (0,0), mag=1, Nmag=0), and resets the lander body animation to frame 'good'.
Lander.reInitialize(xInit,yInit) sets pos/velocity then re-runs the full initialize() routine (resets fuel, mass, thrust, landing-speed thresholds, alarm/boulder flags) used by reset().

ControlButton wraps a movie clip: onRollOver bolds its label text field, onRollOut un-bolds it; onPress nudges the clip +2px/+2px (visual press feedback); onRelease (and onReleaseOutside, same handler) reverts the -2px/-2px nudge and then invokes the bound buttonAction() callback.
The Start button is constructed with buttonAction = null, so releasing it still performs the button's own press/release visual nudge but its callback invocation is a no-op (calling a null action).
The Reset button is constructed with buttonAction = _root.reset, so releasing it performs the same reset described above.

help() toggles motionPaused together with the help-plaque overlay's visibility: opening it pauses motion (stopMotion, stopAllSounds) and shows the paused sign + help plaque; a second press reverses both (restartMotion, hide help plaque and paused sign).
The help button's own display frame (onRollOver/onRollOut) is chosen based on the current motionPaused flag, independent of whether help() itself is invoked (which only happens on onPress).

Each rendered frame (updateGame), the lander's physics position in meters is converted to screen pixels at pixPerMeter(7): landerHolder_mc._x = pos.x*7, landerHolder_mc._y = 0.9*stageH - pos.y*7, so y=0 (ground) maps to 90% of stage height.

Camera zoom: if the lander's screen-space Y exceeds 75% of stage height and Nmag<1, mag is multiplied by 3 and Nmag incremented (zoom out); if it drops below 5% of stage height and Nmag>-2, mag is divided by 3 and Nmag decremented (zoom in); resetView() is called to apply the new scale/offset to view_mc, centered horizontally on the lander.

Horizontal panning: if the lander's screen-space X falls below 10% of stage width (scaled by mag) or exceeds 90% of stage width, view_mc._x is repositioned to keep the lander within that horizontal band.

Each frame, the lander clip's rotation is set to angle*radToDeg (radToDeg = 180/pi), and the thrust-flame clip's _yscale = 200*(thrust/maxThrust) and _alpha = 20 + 60*(thrust/maxThrust), giving a flame that grows and brightens with thrust.

Velocity/acceleration arrows (hidden by default, velAccArrows_mc._visible=false and arrowsShown=false at init) are only recomputed/drawn when arrowsShown is true: each arrow's width/height is 15 (and 0.25*15 for height) times the respective vector magnitude, and its rotation is -radToDeg*atan2(componentY, componentX).

HUD gauges each frame: artificial-horizon gimbal rotation mirrors lander angle; a height readout shows round(pos.y); a 'thrust' panel text field (path GUIPanel_mc.thrust_mc.height_txt) shows round(thrust); a range readout shows round(pos.x); fuelGauge_mc/vY_mc/vX_mc are updated via their own .update() methods (not provided).

Boulder collision check each frame: two probe points are computed at the lander body's right/left edges (±0.45*bodyWidth horizontally, +0.32*bodyHeight vertically from the holder's position) and hit-tested against boulders_mc. A right-side hit (if boulderCrash not already set) zeroes thrust, sets velocity.x=-2, sets angle to -10° (in radians), sets boulderCrash=true, switches the body clip to 'rightDamage', and forces remaining fuel to 0; a left-side hit mirrors this with velocity.x=+2, angle=+10°, and body frame 'leftDamage'.

Landing/report UI: when crashState transitions away from 'inFlight' and landerLanded was false, the score keeper's updateLandings() is called and its score redisplayed, nbrLandings increments and a numbered 'landingMarkN' clip is attached at the lander's position (offset down by 0.38*landerBody height), and the landing-speed report panel is shown with message1 = 'Landing speed = ' + landingSpeed rounded to 1 decimal + ' m/s'. message2 is chosen by crashState: 'softLanded' -> softLanding_str, 'hardLanded' -> hardLanding_str, 'crashLanded' with rounded speed <= damageLandingSpeed(12) -> crashDamaged_str and body frame 'bottomDamage', 'crashLanded' with rounded speed > 12 -> crashKilled_str and body frame 'destroyed'. message3/message4 show the score keeper's nbrSoftLandings/nbrHardLandings.
If crashState returns to 'inFlight' while landerLanded was true (i.e. a new flight begins after a landing), landerLanded is cleared and the boulder-crash/landing-speed report panels are hidden.
If myLander.boulderCrash is true, the boulder-crash report panel is shown every frame (independent of the landing-speed report logic).

The main timeline waits each frame for simStrings.isLoaded() to become true, then detaches its own onEnterFrame handler and calls init() once, which performs all one-time setup (attaching library clips, positioning UI via Util.setXYPosition, wiring the key listener and buttons, and constructing myLander/myScoreKeeper).

outputs.name: landerHolder_mc position/rotation/flame
outputs.description: On-screen lander clip position (pixels, from pos*pixPerMeter and camera pan/zoom), rotation (angle*radToDeg), and thrust-flame scale/alpha.

outputs.name: GUIPanel_mc readouts
outputs.description: Artificial-horizon rotation, height, thrust, and range text fields, plus fuel/vY/vX gauge clips, updated every frame.

outputs.name: scoreReadout_mc.score_txt
outputs.description: Displayed score text, updated after each landing and on reset, sourced from myScoreKeeper (not provided).

outputs.name: landingSpeedReport_mc / boulderCrashReport_mc
outputs.description: Popup panels shown with landing-speed/severity text or boulder-collision notice, hidden on reset or on a fresh takeoff.

outputs.name: landerBody_mc animation frame
outputs.description: Visual damage state of the lander body: 'good', 'bottomDamage', 'destroyed', 'rightDamage', or 'leftDamage' depending on landing/collision outcome.

outputs.name: landingMarkN clips
outputs.description: Persistent markers attached to the view at each landing location, cleared on reset.

outputs.name: pausedSign_mc / helpPlaque_mc visibility
outputs.description: Shown while motionPaused (via P key or help()) is true.

outputs.name: Audio cues (via mySoundMaker)
outputs.description: Thrust loop, side-thruster, alarm (default/low-fuel/out-of-fuel), and explosion sounds, triggered per the rules above; exact audio implementation is in SoundMaker, which was not provided.

notes: SoundMaker, ScoreKeeper, Util, Internationalizer, and the edu.colorado.phet.flashcommon.* classes (FlashCommon, CommonButtons, SimStrings) are referenced throughout DoAction.as and Lander.as but were not provided; their exact internal behavior (sound playback, scoring rules, stage-dimension constants, localization/loading) could not be verified from the given files.
Stage dimensions stageW/stageH are read from Util.STAGEW/Util.STAGEH (DoAction.as:378-379); their actual pixel values are unknown since Util.as was not supplied.

The Start button's bound action is null (DoAction.as:40). No code in the 4 given files calls startMotion(), startGame(), or assigns onEnterFrame=updateGame in response to any input. Based solely on these files it is unclear what actually begins the per-frame game loop/rendering; this looks like it may be wired from code outside what was provided.
Line 293 of DoAction.as ('s;') references an undefined variable with no effect - likely decompiler-visible dead code, not a real mechanic.

DoAction.as:226-229 (Lander.setThrust overflow branch): when requested thrust exceeds maxThrust, this.thrust is clamped to maxThrust but adjustThrustSound() is still called with the original uncapped thrust value, so the percentage passed to the (unavailable) sound engine can exceed 100. Reported as observed, not as a guessed intent.

DoAction.as:208: the in-panel thrust readout text field is at path GUIPanel_mc.thrust_mc.height_txt, reusing the 'height_txt' field name inside the thrust gauge clip; flagged as a possible naming inconsistency in the original asset rather than assumed intentional.

DoAction.as:106: Spacebar sets thrust to the local variable 'maxThrust', a value copied once from myLander.maxThrust at init (DoAction.as:145). In the given files this value never changes afterward, so the cache is never stale, but it is a separate variable from myLander.maxThrust.

Absolute on-stage sizes/shapes of the referenced library symbols (GUIPanel, boulders, landerHolder, landingLine, landingSpots, introPlaque, etc.) beyond the relative X/Y fractions set in init() (DoAction.as:21-34) are defined in library assets not included here, so real geometry/collision shapes cannot be verified.

damageLandingSpeed (12, Lander.as:58) is not used inside Lander.as's own landing classification (which only distinguishes soft/hard via thresholds 2 and 6); it is used only in DoAction.as's detectLanding() to choose between 'legs damaged' and 'crew killed' messaging/graphics for an already-classified 'crashLanded' landing.
